units.source_scale_reason: One fixed anatomical scale per original source matches the existing approximately 190px helmet-to-sole body. Pelvis and planted soles provide registration; no per-pose resizing or deformation.

visual_review.notes: Original paintings and actual Godot 128px phase render inspected for near-arm spear and far-arm shield ownership, articulated grip, thrust, brace/rally and collapse. Clipped idle tip, excessive windup spear and repeated same-leg gait replaced. Consistent anatomical size, visible alternating knees, dedicated shield raise, complete pennons and released corpse equipment verified at battle size. Imported battle/map verification follows publication.
